name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for ST Students
short_description: Scholarship for eligible ST students in recognized post-matriculation and post-secondary courses.
department: Ministry of Tribal Affairs and State/UT implementing authorities
degree_level: Class XI onward / recognized post-secondary courses
stipend_amount: Compulsory non-refundable fees plus stipend; rates depend on course group and day-scholar/hosteller status

validation_rules.label: Scheduled Tribe category
validation_rules.expected: Applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe category in their domicile State/UT.

validation_rules.label: Annual family income
validation_rules.expected: Family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000/year; orphan-supported-by-guardian exemption applies

validation_rules.label: Recognized post-matric course
validation_rules.expected: Course must be recognized by the competent approving authority

validation_rules.label: Eligible institution
validation_rules.expected: Institution must meet one of the guideline institution categories

validation_rules.label: Other scholarship
validation_rules.expected: Only one scholarship/stipend at a time

validation_rules.label: Top Class duplication
validation_rules.expected: Students in Top Class institutes should apply under National Scholarship Scheme, subject to transition provisions

required_documents.name: Family income certificate
required_documents.description: Income certificate from competent authority; self-declaration is not accepted

required_documents.name: Student bank/Aadhaar details
required_documents.description: Valid scheduled bank account linked with Aadhaar/mobile

selection_notes: Income certificate required; self-declarations/affidavits of self-assessed income are not acceptable.
Income ceiling ₹2.5 lakh/year; orphan supported by guardian is exempt.
Rates and eligibility administration involve State/UT authorities and State Level Fee Fixation Committee; values are not hardcoded as one nationwide award.
